The solid lines show confirmed in-hospital case fatality and are the primary results for this briefing. In 2022–2023, confirmed case fatality after stroke was 21% in women and 22% in men; after heart attack it was 27% in women and 19% in men. From 2020 onwards, some discharge outcomes require further verification. The dotted lines and shaded regions show how the estimates would change if probable in-hospital deaths were included. They are a sensitivity range, not the headline values. The widening uncertainty in recent periods should be interpreted as a data-completeness issue alongside any possible change in clinical outcomes.
